A1.justification: Both PDFs describe JPEG Inspired Deep Learning and contain complete, readable main texts and Appendices A.1–A.12. Their equations, figures, tables, and relocated material support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original JPEG-DL classification experiments, adversarial robustness tests, ablations, and inference measurements in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including classification results in Tables 1–3 and appendix comparisons and timing measurements.

M1.justification: The soft quantizer, joint JPEG/DNN optimization, gradient scaling, layer-replacement variant, and masked-CPMF inference procedure are unchanged. Figure 1's revised caption clarifies the existing architecture without changing its procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate CIFAR-100, ImageNet-1K, CUB-200, Stanford Dogs, Flowers, and Pets, with the same classification and adversarial evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including Ballé et al., Shin and Song, and Esser et al. in Table 6, and JPEG augmentation, denoising, equalization, and learnable resizing in Table 8.

E3.justification: Training schedules, optimizers, learning rates, model configurations, accuracy metrics, FGSM/PGD settings, and inference-timing procedures remain unchanged in Sections 4–5 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same robustness tests, layer-replacement experiments, chrominance-subsampling and learning-rate comparisons, feature visualizations, and quantizer analyses. Appendix A.12's masked-versus-full CPMF analysis is retained, not newly added.

E5.justification: The same tables report means and standard deviations over three runs. Table 5 retains its explicit different-random-seed statement; no uncertainty-reporting or statistical procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains DenseNet-121's Flowers accuracy of 72.22 ± 1.05, and Table 11 retains inference times of 5.46, 7.43, and 18.86 milliseconds for baseline, masked CPMF, and full-space CPMF, respectively.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(13), the soft-quantizer definitions, Appendix A.1's derivative derivations, and Appendix A.2's gradient-scaling reasoning are unchanged. Appendix A.12's mathematical discussion is only reflowed.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about jointly trainable JPEG-DL, accuracy improvements up to 20.9%, limited parameter overhead, and improved adversarial robustness.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning additional nonlinearity, foreground/background separation, chrominance sensitivity, and negligible masked-quantizer approximation error remain unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are introduced.

D1.justification: Code access information, hyperparameters, architecture details, and timing hardware remain unchanged. The preprocessing implementation-verification footnote moves from page 19 to page 21 without changing its content or access information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography retain the same cited works and positioning relative to JPEG compression, differentiable quantization, and trainable activation functions. Reference pagination changes without additions or removals.

P1.justification: v3 rewrites Figure 1's caption to clarify fixed JPEG operations and trainable components, and adds funding acknowledgments before the references. The narrative and section sequence remain intact; a stray 'x' appears after Appendix A.11.

P2.justification: The same 13 figures and 11 tables are retained. Figure 1's caption changes, Table 10 moves from page 22 to 23, Table 11 moves from page 24 to 23, and appendix text and footnotes reflow. The final-page header also changes.

improvement.justification: v3 provides a small clarification to Figure 1 and adds funding acknowledgments, while preserving the scientific arguments, experiments, results, and reproducibility information. The remaining layout changes and minor editorial blemish do not materially affect readability or evidential strength, leaving overall quality essentially unchanged.
